name: GATA binding protein 4

function.text: GATA4 encodes transcription factor GATA-4. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to GATA4-related congenital heart disease with or without pancreatic hypoplasia or diabetes (autosomal dominant); atrial septal defect 2 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Esophageal adenocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
